title: Steelers list Rico Dowdle, DeShon Elliott as questionable

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steelers list Rico Dowdle, DeShon Elliott as questionable
sources.description: The Steelers planned to have a walkthrough at Stade de France after arriving in Paris on Friday morning, but bad weather scrapped those plans and they'll hold their final practice ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints on Saturday.
